p.title: Policy-rate surfaces show the FOMC target range, not the FEDFUNDS monthly average
p.symptom: The global policy-rate table compared BOK 3.00% with US 3.63% (FEDFUNDS August average), and the macro 'now' card and CP2 showed 3.63 while the same app reported the 2026-09-16 decision 3.75-4.00%.
p.root_cause: DATA_SNAPSHOT.fedRate started as the official range and was overwritten by the server FEDFUNDS monthly average; one key carried two concepts.
p.fix: Producer adds FRED DFEDTARL/DFEDTARU; new fed-target sink (legacy map and native market.js) shows the range with source, falling back to the official FOMC decision registry; the monthly-average card keeps fed-rate.
p.violated_rule: One metric, one meaning; compare like with like.
p.prevention: Native readSnapshotMetric handles fed-target explicitly; browser check shows '3.75-4.00% · FOMC 결정 2026-09-16' on macro and signal.
p.verification: Local browser verification on macro and signal routes.
